newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta stocks end up on Telkom, small stocks.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta stocks end up on Telkom, small stocks.

text.p: Jakarta stocks ended higher on Monday after bargain hunting in Telkom and speculative buying in selected small stocks, brokers said.
News that Indonesia's fabled Busang gold field was a dud did not affect overall sentiment but pushed tin miner Tambang Timah down albeit in small volume, they said.
"Overall sentiment was firm despite the Busang reports as none of the listed companies here are members in the Busang consortium," one broker said.
